title: Coarse-to-Fine Crack Cue for Robust Crack Detection
core_idea: Leverage the thin-structure property of cracks to generate a robust crack cue via a coarse-to-fine pipeline: apply max-pooling and upsampling to produce a coarse crack-free background, refine it with a reconstruction network to obtain a fine crack-free background, then subtract this from the original image to produce a fine crack cue that encodes crack priors and can be plugged into existing crack detection networks to guide detection under complex backgrounds, shadows, and varied lighting.
tldr: A plug-and-play coarse-to-fine method that creates a fine crack cue (coarse background via max-pooling+upsampling, refined by reconstruction, then subtracted from the original) to guide robust crack detection focused on thin structures.
